items.title: USN-9084-1: Radicale vulnerability

items.title: USN-9083-1: gevent vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that the gevent WSGI server incorrectly validated chunked transfer encoding trailers in HTTP requests. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to perform HTTP request smuggling attacks, leading to privilege escalation.

items.title: USN-9082-1: pngquant vulnerability
